title: adaptive-fidelity-orchestration-and-evaluation-checklist-2026
author: Priya Narayanan
content:
Summary

This page defines the Adaptive Fidelity Orchestration pattern we use to balance latency, cost, and output quality in the inference-runtime. It documents the telemetry contract, decision matrix, rollout and evaluation checklist, and emergency rollback procedures used by runtime, scheduling, and ops teams.

Goal

- Enable safe, measurable fidelity degradations (quantization, smaller variants, reduced sampling) to preserve SLOs during pressure events while keeping quality regressions bounded and observable.
- Provide a reproducible evaluation checklist for any fidelity-orchestration rollout or experiment.

Scope

Applies to: hosted API, Dedicated pools, and Private deployments using the inference-runtime components: scheduler, kernel-mapper, fallback-router, kv-cache, and telemetry-pipeline. Does NOT include model training or model selection upstream (use model-onboarding docs for that).

Key concepts and vocabulary

- Fidelity action: an operational change that reduces computational work per request (e.g., lower quantization, switch to 8-bit kernel, prune attention heads, reduce beam width, shorten context window).
- Fidelity policy: declarative rules that map runtime signals to fidelity actions. Policies are evaluated in the scheduler and enacted via the fallback-router.
- Fidelity event: telemetry emission when a policy evaluates to a non-default action (see Telemetry Contract).

High-level architecture (text diagram)

inference-api -> request-router -> scheduler -> kernel-mapper -> gpu-dispatcher -> kernels
                                         |
                                         v
                                fallback-router -> model-variant-store
                                         |
                                         v
                                 telemetry-pipeline -> metrics/trace/store

The scheduler consults fidelity policies at decision points (admission, pre-dispatch, warmstart). The fallback-router performs model swaps and quantization-profile changes with KV warm-up hints.

Telemetry contract (mandatory)

Every fidelity action must generate these telemetry events (span-based + metrics):

- execution.fidelity_check (span tag): {policy_id, trigger_signal, evaluated_at, decision}
- execution.fidelity_change (counter): increments when an action is applied (labels: action_type, pool, model_family, rollout_id)
- kernel_selection.hint (gauge): kernel_name selected for request (sampled 1%)
- kernel_latency_ms (histogram): end-to-end kernel latency after action (p50/p95/p99 buckets)
- quality.regression_signal (counter + sample): when offline/online eval detects quality drop > threshold (labels: eval_suite, prompt_set)

Sampling and retention

- Default fidelity_check sampling: 5% (increase to 100% for canaries or error bursts).
- kernel_latency_ms retained for 90 days; fidelity_change events retained 365 days.

Decision matrix (example)

When pool CPU/GPU metrics cross thresholds, follow ordered actions. Each action is additive unless explicitly exclusive in the policy.

| Signal | Threshold | Primary action | Quality guard | Rollback threshold |
|--------|-----------|----------------|---------------|-------------------|
| GPU_util | > 92% over 2m | enable-8bit-kernel | offline eval loss delta < 0.8% | GPU_util < 85% for 5m |
| p95 latency | > target*1.3 | reduce-batch-size (limit concurrency) | p50 latency steady | p95 < target*1.1 |
| queue-depth | > 500 | degrade-fidelity: short-context (truncate 50 tokens) | quality delta < 1.5% | queue-depth < 200 |
| memory_pressure | > 80% | kvcache-evict-older-prefetch | no data loss | memory_pressure < 60% |

Policy format (YAML example)

policy_id: fast_sustain_2026
description: "Reduce compute during sustained high GPU utilization while preserving output quality"
triggers:
  - signal: gpu_util
    operator: ">="
    value: 92
    window: 120s
actions:
  - name: enable_quantized_kernel
    params:
      mode: 8bit
      models: ["gpt-medium-family"]
  - name: kvcache_prefetch_mode
    params: {mode: conservative}
guards:
  - type: offline_eval
    eval_suite: "regression-critical-prompts"

Rollout and evaluation checklist (pre-deployment)

1. Author policy in repo: infra/fidelity-policies/<policy_id>.yaml, include rationale and owner.
2. Unit tests for policy parser and basic simulation of triggers (use fidelity-sim harness).
3. Local simulation: run replay of 24h production trace in sandbox, record cost and eval metrics vs baseline.
4. Canary deploy: select 1% of traffic in one Dedicated pool with 100% telemetry sampling.
5. Run online A/B for 48h: compare key metrics: p95 latency, tokens-per-second, offline eval pass rate.
6. Post-canary review: reviewers must sign off in PR checks and add sign-off tags.
7. Automated gradual ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with health gates at each step.

Health gates (automated)

- p95 latency must not regress > 10% vs baseline for two consecutive windows of 30m.
- quality.regression_signal rate must be <= 0.5x historical rate for the same prompt set for 24h.
- cost-per-token must not increase more than 2% (goal is net decrease).

Emergency rollback procedures

1. Alerting: fidelity-change if rate spikes > 10x baseline for 5m or quality.regression_signal exceeds configured threshold triggers a P1 paging to eng-sre.
2. Automated rollback CLI (useful for oncall):

# Stop policy evaluation and revert to default profile
redwoodctl runtime fidelity suspend --policy fast_sustain_2026 --scope pool:us-west-1-dedicated
redwoodctl runtime fidelity rollback --policy fast_sustain_2026 --to default_profile

3. Manual model swap (if rollback CLI fails): update fallback-router policy to route to model-variant-store:default.

Quality evaluation (offline and online)

- Offline: must run 'regression-critical-prompts' and 'semantic-stability-suite' on 2,000 prompt pairs. Thresholds:
  - semantic-stability delta (BLEU/ROUGE-style proxies) < 0.8%
  - hallucination increase < 0.5% (measured by hallucination-sign detector)
- Online: shadow traffic evaluation with stash/score mode: sample 0.5% of live requests and score against golden answers or human raters.

Owner and contacts

- Policy owner: eng-serving-runtime (Priya N., priya@redwood.ai)
- Scheduler owner: Miguel Santos (miguel@redwood.ai)
- Oncall: eng-sre rotation (see /oncall roster link)

Integrations and operational notes

- Observability: ensure fidelity_change and kernel_latency_ms are exposed as Prometheus metrics and ingested by observability alerting rules.
- Alerts: add a dedicated alert group 'Fidelity Guardrails' with thresholds matching the health gates.
- Audit: every policy change must create an entry in config-audit (timestamp, author, diff).

Acceptance criteria for merging policy PR

- All unit tests pass.
- Canary simulation logs attached and include kernel_latency_ms distributions.
- Reviewer sign-offs from runtime, SRE, and applied-ml teams.
- Rollback playbook references (this doc + runbook link).

Guidance for private deployments

Private deployments often have constrained telemetry. In that case:
- Require 100% local fidelity_check sampling for the canary period.
- Run longer canary windows (72h) before global rollout.
- Default to conservative actions (e.g., reduce-batch-size before quantization) when offline_eval data is limited.

Operational runbook snippets

- To force a specific fidelity action for investigation:
redwoodctl runtime fidelity apply --policy test_investigation --action reduce_context --params '{"tokens":50}' --scope pool:debug-sandbox

- Query recent fidelity events (last 2h):
query-metrics "execution.fidelity_change{pool=\"us-west-1-dedicated\"}" --from now-120m --to now

- Promote a canary policy to global (after sign-off):
1) Ensure automated ramp script is configured in deploy-runner.
2) kubectl apply -f infra/fidelity-policies/fast_sustain_2026.yaml --context=deploy-runner

Appendix: example evaluation table (pass thresholds)

| Evaluation suite | Metric | Baseline | Allowed delta | Pass
|------------------|--------|----------|---------------|------
| regression-critical-prompts | semantic-stability | 0.812 | -0.006 (<=0.8%) | required
| hallucination-smoke | hallucination-rate | 0.045 | +0.0025 (<=0.5%) | required
| latency-sla-proxy | p95 (ms) | 230 | +25 (<=10%) | required
